cited_sources.text: 3 EXPERIMENTS 3.1 Dataset We conduct experiments on two datasets: AliMe and Quora. The Al- iMe dataset is collected from the AliMe intelligent assistant system and the Quora dataset is composed of a public dataset. AliMe For the AliMe service in E-commerce, we collect 8,004 query-bag pairs to form our dataset. Negative sampling is also an important part of the matching model. For each query, we use the Lucene2 to retrieval the top-20 most similar questions from the whole question candidates.

In addition to the mutual coverage, a bag representa- tion in word level is issued to help discover the main points of a bag. The bag representation then provides new matching evidence to the query-bag matching model. We conduct experiments on the AliMe and Quora dataset for the query-bag matching based information-seeking conversation. Compared with baselines, we verify the effectiveness of our model.

Query-bag Matching with Mutual Coverage for Information-seeking Conversations in E-commerce Zhenxin Fu∗ fuzhenxin@pku.edu.cn zhongxiu.jf@alibaba-inc.com WICT, Peking University DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group Wei Zhou Dongyan Zhao fayi.zw@alibaba-inc.com zhaodongyan@pku.edu.cn DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group WICT, Peking University arXiv:1911.02747v1 [cs.CL] 7 Nov 2019 ruiyan@pku.edu.cn WICT, Peking University ABSTRACT Information-seeking conversation system aims at satisfying the information needs of users through conversations.
